description: This file provides function declarations for Base64 encoding and decoding operations, intended for use as helper functions in a C project.

methods.name: icEncodeBase64
methods.description: Encodes a binary array into a Base64 string. The caller should free the returned string if not NULL.

methods.name: icDecodeBase64
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 encoded string into a binary array. Returns true if successful, and the caller must free the array.
